articles.title: Season 'not good enough' but Diamondbacks, Lovullo agree to 2-year deal
articles.description: Arizona is betting on continuity, keeping Torey Lovullo alongside GM Mike Hazen through 2028 despite a third straight playoff miss.

articles.title: Diamondbacks takeaways. What to do with Ketel Marte, offseason upgrades
articles.description: General manager Mike Hazen was asked about more than just Torey Lovullo's status at his end-of-year session, including Ketel Marte's future.

articles.title: Diamondbacks send pitcher to Cardinals to complete Lars Nootbaar trade
articles.description: The Diamondbacks sent pitching prospect Brian Curley to the St. Louis Cardinals to complete the deal that brought outfielder Lars Nootbaar to Arizona.

articles.title: Watch Torey Lovullo and Mike Hazen at Diamondbacks news conference
articles.description: The Arizona Diamondbacks' Torey Lovullo and Mike Hazen answer questions during a press conference at Chase Field in Phoenix on Oct. 1, 2026.

articles.title: No matter what, Arizona’s baseball team deserves moniker of the Battle-Backs
articles.description: It wasn’t the end of the season that Arizona Diamondbacks fans wanted, but somehow it felt different from previous years.

articles.title: Ketel Marte video after playoff elimination enrages Diamondbacks fans
articles.description: A video of Ketel Marte circulating on social media has riled up Arizona Diamondbacks fans after team's elimination from MLB postseason contention.

articles.title: Diamondbacks' Torey Lovullo on his future. 'I want to be wanted'
articles.description: Diamondbacks manager Torey Lovullo seemed to suggest his return wasn't an automatic if the club wanted to retain him.

articles.title: Diamondbacks' Gabriel Moreno wins 1st batting title in franchise history
articles.description: The Diamondbacks' Gabriel Moreno won the first batting title in franchise history, though he did not wrap it up the way he would have liked.

articles.title: Diamondbacks' stunning run at playoff dream ends on season's final day
articles.description: The Diamondbacks need to win — and need help from the Phillies — on Sunday, Sept. 27, as they continue their late push for a wild-card spot.
